text_sanskrit: एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन । अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते ॥ १-३५ ॥
itrans: etAnna hantumichChAmi ghnato.api madhusUdana . api trailokyarAjyasya hetoH kiM nu mahIkR^ite .. 1-35 ..
translation: O Madhusudana, though they (would) kill (me), and though it be for the kingship of the three worlds; how then for earth? In slaying the sons of Dhritarashtra, what pleasure can be ours, Janardana?
